body: Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

The className construction should use the `cn()` utility from `@object-ui/components` to properly merge Tailwind classes. Currently, the `border` class and `border-l-[3px]` may conflict during class merging. Import `cn` and use it like: `cn('border rounded-lg p-2.5...', leftBorderClass && 'border-l-[3px]', leftBorderClass)` to ensure proper class precedence and deduplication.

The combined date+percent row uses `justify-between` which will cause the single item to align unexpectedly when only date OR percent is present (not both). Consider using `justify-start` with a `gap-4` or similar, or conditionally applying `justify-between` only when both values are present.
